name: Senir's Observations
summary: Grelin Whitebeard sends you east from Coldridge Valley with his report for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos. The tunnel out is overrun by troggs, and Mountaineer Thalos guards the way.

sections.title: A Courier for the Whitebeards
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard has documented troll activity around Coldridge Valley. After Frostmane trolls stole his journal and it was recovered, he decided the report was too important for an inexperienced apprentice to carry. He sends you directly to his brother, Senir Whitebeard, who works outside the valley in Kharanos.

sections.title: The Blocked Pass to Kharanos
sections.body: The eastern tunnel is the road from Coldridge Valley to the rest of Dun Morogh, but troggs have overrun it. Mountaineer Thalos stands outside the passage to keep civilians from entering danger. He lets travelers through only when they carry urgent official business.

faq.q: Who is Grelin sending this report to?
faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard sends the report to Senir Whitebeard, his brother, who is in Kharanos assessing regional concerns.

faq.q: Why can't Grelin's apprentice deliver the report?
faq.answer: Grelin first planned to send his apprentice, but Frostmane trolls stole his journal. The information was too important to entrust to inexperienced hands.

faq.q: Why is the tunnel out of Coldridge Valley guarded?
faq.answer: Troggs have overrun the tunnel from Coldridge Valley into Dun Morogh. Mountaineer Thalos guards its mouth to keep civilians safe until the way is clear.
Mountaineer Thalos watches east of Anvilmar, near the entrance to the tunnel leading from Coldridge Valley toward Kharanos.

faq.q: What allows you to pass through the trogg-infested tunnel?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos lets you enter because you carry Grelin Whitebeard's urgent dispatch.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Mountaineer Thalos?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos warns you about the dangerous tunnel and guides you before allowing you to continue east toward Kharanos.

angles.text: As a dwarven mountaineer or recruit, you pass through the eastern tunnel on your first official deployment beyond Coldridge Valley's training grounds.
As a gnomish refugee living among the Bronzebeards, you can carry this dispatch out of your first haven and toward the troubles gripping Dun Morogh.
You help keep passage between dwarven valleys secure, protecting Ironforge and Alliance couriers.
